description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and structures related to messaging and event handling within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes definitions for message metadata, event serialization/deserialization, control interfaces, and message storage mechanisms.

classes.name: IEvent
classes.description: Interface for event objects that can be serialized and deserialized, providing access to their data.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Class storing basic information about a message, including type, category, and module.

classes.name: IControl
classes.description: Interface for control objects that can be enabled, destroyed, and provide metadata.

classes.name: MessageInfo
classes.description: Class extending Metadata, adding a timestamp to message information.

classes.name: IStore
classes.description: Interface responsible for storing and pushing message data, with singleton access methods.

classes.name: Logging
classes.description: Derived class from MessageInfo for logging messages.

classes.name: Tracing
classes.description: Derived class from MessageInfo for tracing messages, including file name, line number, and class name.

classes.name: WarningReporting
classes.description: Derived class from MessageInfo for warning reports, including a callsign.

methods.name: Metadata::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Metadata object into a buffer.

methods.name: Metadata::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into the Metadata object.

methods.name: MessageInfo::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the MessageInfo object into a buffer.

methods.name: MessageInfo::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into the MessageInfo object.

methods.name: MessageInfo::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MessageInfo object.
